envelope.description: Fixture scroll metrics and registry paging companions

body.title: Fixture scroll metrics and registry paging companions
body.summary: Add scrollTop, scrollHeight and clientHeight to the shared __tests__/fake-dom.ts (no second fake DOM). Add three companions to the render registry's returned object: forgetKeysBefore(index), which drops the r<n> keys below an index; withIsolatedPending(fn), which runs a render with an empty pending-tool list and restores the live list afterwards; and forgetPendingIn(nodes), which drops pending tool entries whose row node is one of the given nodes.
acceptanceChecks: fake-dom.ts nodes carry scrollTop, scrollHeight and clientHeight, and its existing tests pass
forgetKeysBefore drops only the r<n> keys below the index; other keys and nodes are untouched
withIsolatedPending runs the render with an empty pending list and restores the live list afterwards, also when the render throws
forgetPendingIn drops exactly the pending entries whose node is given; a later tool result for a dropped entry renders as its own row
The existing registry tests pass unchanged

tests.name: registry forgetKeysBefore drops only the r<n> keys below the index; withIsolatedPending runs a render with an empty pending-tool list and restores the live list afterwards
registry forgetPendingIn drops the pending tool entries whose node is given, and a later result for one renders as its own row
fake-dom nodes carry scrollTop, scrollHeight and clientHeight
